entities.summary: Sabina Orellana Cruz is a Bolivian unionist and politician of Quechua origin who served as Minister of Cultures, Decolonization and Depatriarchalization under President Luis Arce from 2020 to 2024. She is a member of the Bartolina Sisa Confederation of indigenous women.
